lhs: Sequential left rotations of a base tensor by a finite chain of signed axis shifts.
rhs: Base when the sorted normalized shift list is empty; otherwise one rotation with that list.
conditions: Finite in-range axis/shift pairs flattened from the chain in outer-to-inner order. Base values depend only on declared visible coordinates (all-visible admits arbitrary tensors). Exact integer sums, no host overflow claim.
types: Arbitrary finite rank, natural static extents, arbitrary logical element type, signed mathematical shifts; scalar and empty tensor domains included.
overlap: Both source returns are branches of one canonicalization. The historical 118 have no rotation rule; previous candidate worksheets have no checked cyclic rotation operator. Reuses tensor/index definitions and shipped modular arithmetic.

conditions: Any rank and extents with product > 1 and length-matched storage; adjacent scalar representations compare equal.
types: A fixed exact scalar domain with decidable equality.
overlap: Pilot.ConstantGuardLemmas proves a Bool storage-recognition lemma for an externally supplied value; first-scalar reconstruction for arbitrary exact element types is the terminal case here.

conditions: Length > 1; prior uniform branch declined; serial recognition checks each literal element against the fixed encoding of its index.

lhs: Stored dense rank-one integer literal xs

types: Unbounded mathematical integers; machine overflow and representation conversion excluded.
overlap: Reuses position scan induction in this batch; computes stride from the input and separately constructs iota, broadcast multiplier and product values.

overlap: Signed add/sub/mul use earlier promoted scalar laws. Four different operations, distinct from remainder. No inherited source-row evidence at baseline.

lhs: Read the singleton slice of Iota.
rhs: Clamp the start using a representable typed upper endpoint, convert to element type, reshape to a singleton.
conditions: Rank one of any positive length, output extent 1; signedness of index and element independent.
types: S32 or U32 word values and modular multiplication.
overlap: Same-type and conversion aliases grouped. Non-Iota nested fallthrough has different inputs and replacement.

conditions: Rank one of any positive length, output extent 1; signedness of index and element independent.
types: S32 or U32 word values and modular multiplication.
overlap: Same-type and conversion aliases grouped. Non-Iota nested fallthrough has different inputs and replacement.
